name: Gilles Andriamahazo
role: Malagasy politician, brief head of state of Madagascar in 1975
contribution: A Malagasy general and political figure.
legacy: He is widely credited with having prevented an outbreak of civil war during the tension that followed Colonel Ratsimandrava's assassination.

checks.lead: General Gilles Andriamahazo (5 May 1919 – 13 September 1989) was a Malagasy general and political figure. He served as the head of state of Madagascar (Chairman of the National Military Leadership Committee) and minister of defense between 12 February and 15 June 1975.
